Callout.Name: Illegal Camp - River Bank
Callout.Message: Camp on the river bank on private land.
Callout.Advisory: Three tents, fire lit, landowner reporting.

Script.Line: We have been here three weeks and nobody has said anything.
The fire is for cooking and it is in a ring.
Where are we supposed to go? Tell me where to go.

Lines.Approach: Three tents, a fire, and it is on the wrong side of the fence. The owner wants them moved.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
